title: Market Share
excerpt: Market Share is the percentage of total industry sales or revenue captured by a company within a specific market or segment.

seo.note: Not present in export (no Yoast/RankMath fields). excerpt is derived from the body.

blocks.html: Market Share is the percentage of total industry sales or revenue captured by a company within a specific market or segment.

Market Share is a key performance metric used to evaluate a company’s competitive position within its industry. It shows how much of the total market demand a business is serving compared to its competitors. A higher market share typically indicates stronger brand presence, customer preference, and competitive advantage.
Market Share is calculated by dividing a company’s sales by the total sales of the industry over a specific period:

items.title: Market Share (%) = (Company Sales ÷ Total Market Sales) × 100
Company Sales
items.html: refers to revenue generated by the business in a defined market

items.title: Total Market Sales
items.html: represents overall industry revenue within the same period

blocks.html: Market share can be measured by revenue, units sold, or customer base depending on the industry.
Indicates competitive strength within an industry
Helps evaluate business growth relative to competitors
Identifies opportunities for expansion or improvement
Provides insight into brand positioning and performance
If the total revenue of a software market is ₹1,000 crore and a company generates ₹150 crore in sales, its market share is 15%.

Market Share is a critical indicator of a company’s position in the industry. By tracking and improving market share, businesses can strengthen competitiveness, increase revenue, and achieve long-term growth.
